Subject: Meet Northbay — and the sock built for the long haul
CTA: Shop Trailwool Socks -> https://www.northbaysupply.com/products/NB-SOK-11
Body: Hey there,

Welcome to Northbay Supply. We're a gear brand built around one idea: the right kit should get out of your way and let you focus on the trail. No hype, no excess — just well-considered gear for people who already know what they're doing out there.

Today we're launching something we've been quiet about for a while: the Trailwool Sock.

Here's what it is:

- Merino wool blend construction. Merino regulates temperature and resists odor over multi-day use, so you're not digging through your pack for a fresh pair every night.
- Three pairs per pack (NB-SOK-11). That's a full rotation for a standard backpacking trip without the repack math.

What it's not: it's not a waterproof sock, and it's not designed for heavy mountaineering boots. If you're doing technical ice or need a vapor barrier layer, look elsewhere. For trail running, hiking, and everyday camp use, it does its job and stays comfortable doing it.

No markdown this time — just a straightforward introduction to a sock we think you'll reach for often.

If your next trip is on the calendar, now's a good time to get a pack sorted before you're out the door.
